title: Expurgatory Indices leave Marian extremes untouched while cutting Augustine’s anti-temple-to-Saints lines
source_text: LXXVI. Denique idem probant Indices expurgatorii, qui accurate notant & deleri quoque jubent quae suspecta, aut etiam ambigua videntur, in scriptoribus Ecclesiae Romanae: Et tamen intacta sinunt quae in hoc negotio, scandalum Reformatis movent, & quotidie ab illis observantur & objiciuntur, ut modum & rationem omnem longe excedentia. Nec enim quae ex Bernardino, Bembo, Costero, Catharino, citavimus, ulla censura notantur in Indicibus expurgatoriis. Qui tamen Indices jubent, ex Indicibus Augustini deleri sequentes propositiones, Sanctis nec templa statuimus, nec sacrificia. Templa Angelis non sunt constituenda. Sanctis aedificare templa non licet. Templa creaturis aedificare sacrilegium est. Unde merito colligimus illis quibus censura librorum in Ecclesia Romana commissa est, has quidem propositiones aut improbari aut suspectas esse; minime vero illas de quibus jam agimus, & in quibus elogia supra citata B. Virgini tribuuntur.
pass_a_gloss: Finally the same is proved by the expurgatory Indices, which accurately note and also order to be deleted what seems suspect or even ambiguous in the writers of the Roman Church: And yet leave untouched those things which in this business move scandal to the Reformed, and are daily observed and objected by them as far exceeding all measure and reason. For neither are those things which we have cited from Bernardinus, Bembo, Costerus, Catharinus noted with any censure in the expurgatory Indices. Which Indices yet order the following propositions to be deleted from Augustine’s Indices: We neither set up temples to the Saints, nor sacrifices. Temples are not to be constituted to Angels. It is not lawful to build temples to the Saints. To build temples to creatures is sacrilege. Whence we deservedly gather that to those to whom the censure of books in the Roman Church is committed, these propositions indeed are either disapproved or suspect; but by no means those of which we are now treating, and in which the eulogies cited above are attributed to the B. Virgin.
pass_b_english: Expurgatory Indices scrub suspects—but leave these Marian extremes untouched.
They even cut Augustine’s lines against temples to Saints/Angels, while Bernardinus, Bembo, Costerus, Catharinus pass.

choices.why: Institutional evidence of non-censure for Marian elogia.
